champion: Inflammatory Carcinoma of the Breast with Cutaneous Metastasis
ordered_diagnoses: Inflammatory Carcinoma of the Breast with Cutaneous Metastasis

facts.raw_span: A woman in her 30s with a history of right breast cancer, stage IIIa (cT2N2M0)
pruritic erythema lesion with multiple nodules over the operation site of the right breast
The lesion did not respond to initial topical treatments
A well-demarcated, warm, erythematous plaque, 15 × 12 cm, was seen over the right side of the anterior chest wall around her operation scar
Scattered within the erythema were multiple palpable small nodules
Negative for estrogen receptor (ER), progesterone receptor (PR), and human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2)
Multiple emboli of carcinoma cells in dermal and subcutaneous lymphatic vessels
Right mastectomy scar with a large well-defined area of erythema and multiple, scattered small nodules
Nearly complete remission of skin lesions after treatment
